reader_summary.headline: My guests today are Gavin Uberti and Rob Wachen, the founders of Etched.
reader_summary.overview: My guests today are Gavin Uberti and Rob Wachen, the founders of Etched. A few years ago, when they set out to build a better AI chip than the largest companies in the world. They have since done it, taping out a working chip on their first attempt and becoming the first hardware company founded after ChatGPT to do so.

key_points.text: A few years ago, when they set out to build a better AI chip than the largest companies in the world.
They already have more than a billion dollars of customer demand for their first product.
Etched builds chips and systems designed to run AI models faster and at lower cost.
